title: Top parking deck/ yellow gates.
content: I believe this to be a different area besides the parking garage , wherever this location is it’s at the top of a parking deck, there are yellow gates all around the outside so you don’t fall off, there are concrete entrances . The deck /platform is a huge rectangle with empty parking spots , there are always people waiting to get in to someone where but I’m not sure were , there are two concrete tall buildings attached and connecting one on the north side of the platform and one and the west side …. Ai didn’t do the best at re creating what I see but has anyone been anywhere similar? Again this is different then the normal rolls coaster/ endless parking garage . And there’s always those yellow gates that stand out .
